rationale: No existing spec covers the Usage Allowance quota dialog (grep for usage_limits/quota/browser_steps/protocol_steps across tests/ui-testing returned zero hits). The closest spec, org.spec.js, covers org CRUD and the _meta admin-org LIST endpoint only — and its GET /organizations assertion (data.list) is documented as stale/wrong and must NOT be copied. The synthetics-steps quota is a distinct feature area (cloud + _meta-gated quota dialog with two step pools) and the run-context provides a dedicated spec_filename/spec_path, so a new spec in GeneralTests is the correct home. Registration: the new file must be appended to the GeneralTests run_files entry in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json (the single source of truth for shard matrix).
